title: Handed to resident??!! I don't think so!
text: Three Amazon gift cards that are to be given to my employees as Christmas gifts. No big deal. Except that I had them shipped to my house on a Saturday knowing that someone would be at home when the package would arrive. I did not see anything show up that day, I had been checking the front door step and mailbox until 6pm (after dark, of course). This morning (the next day) I decided to check to see the status of the package, thinking that it was going to be a late arrival. Order status says that it was delivered on Saturday, and then goes on to say that it was handed to resident. That is just a flat out lie! it was lying on the porch in front of the door (fortunately!). But the doorbell had not been rung, and it certainly wasn't handed to anyone in my house. If you made the delivery and left it on the doorstep, fine, just say that. But don't lie about handing it to someone in the house. That is really irritating. I'm thankful it wasn't stolen. It was small enough that it would not have been noticed from the road, especially after dark.
